We’re a company that genuinely cares about our people, our products, our consumers and the environment.
  
  
Our unique, informal culture champions courage, determination and collaboration. Knowing we have an open and supportive team means each of us has the freedom to take responsibility and ownership. We have a shared passion to work hard, innovate and push boundaries.

We are looking for an experienced
**Shopper Marketing Manager**
to lead the development and delivery of our UK Shopper Marketing strategy across a portfolio of leading brands and retail customers.
  
  
This is a pivotal role within the business, responsible for transforming brand and commercial strategies into compelling shopper experiences that increase conversion, strengthen customer partnerships and deliver profitable growth. You'll have ownership of a significant shopper marketing investment, working closely with Sales, Marketing, Category, eCommerce and external partners to ensure every pound spent delivers measurable commercial value.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Develop and deliver the UK Shopper Marketing strategy, turning brand and commercial objectives into impactful shopper activation plans.
* Manage a significant shopper marketing budget, ensuring investment is targeted, measurable and delivers strong commercial returns.
* Lead customer-specific activation programmes across retail and eCommerce channels, including promotions, launches, seasonal campaigns and in-store activity.

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Category Management and external agencies to create best-in-class shopper experiences.

* Act as the UK shopper marketing expert, influencing business decisions through insight, data and a deep understanding of shopper behaviour.

* Proven ability to manage significant budgets and evaluate investment performance.

If you're passionate about understanding shoppers, delivering commercial results and creating best-in-class activation, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Sr Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Head of Marketing, the Senior Product Marketing Manager will own the go-to-market strategy, positioning, messaging, and sales enablement for our portfolio of SaaS and technology solutions.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Technology, Alliances, and Marketing, ensuring that our solutions are effectively brought to market, differentiated from competitors, and aligned to customer needs. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving product adoption, generating demand, accelerating pipeline growth, and supporting revenue generation across both new and existing customers.
  
  
**Overview:**
To define, develop, and execute the product marketing and go-to-market strategy across our SaaS and technology solutions.
  
  
The Senior Product Marketing Manager will elevate our value proposition, strengthen our market positioning, and ensure our products are communicated effectively to customers, partners, and prospects. Through compelling messaging, thought leadership, sales enablement, and market insight, the role will drive awareness, demand generation, product adoption, pipeline growth, and revenue performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
Product Marketing & Go-to-Market Strategy:
  
  

* Own and execute go-to-market strategies for new products, services, and feature releases.
* Define compelling product positioning, messaging, buyer personas, and value propositions that differentiate our solutions in the market.
* Partner with Product Management and technical teams to ensure market requirements and customer insights are reflected in product strategy.
* Develop launch plans that maximise awareness, engagement, adoption, and commercial success.

Market Intelligence & Customer Insight:
  
  

* Develop a deep understanding of customer challenges, buying behaviours, and decision-making processes by conducting market, customer and competitor research.
* Monitor competitor activity and provide actionable recommendations to strengthen market positioning. Identify partnership and alliance opportunities that support growth objectives.

Demand Generation & Revenue Growth:
  
  

* Collaborate with Performance Marketing, Customer Marketing, Business Development, Sales Leaders, and Vendor Alliance teams to create campaigns that drive demand and measurable pipeline growth.
* Develop campaign messaging and supporting assets that support customer acquisition, retention, upsell, and cross-sell objectives.

Content & Thought Leadership:
  
  

* Lead the development of product marketing assets including whitepapers, videos, Blogs and Articles, Customer case studies and videos, sales enablement materials.
* Work closely with the CTO office, product managers and technical specialists to create thought leadership and intellectual property that establishes the organisation as a recognised industry authority.

Sales Enablement:
  
  

* Equip sales teams with the tools, messaging, training, and collateral required to effectively position solutions and accelerate opportunities through the sales cycle.
* Create and maintain sales playbooks, battlecards, objection-handling guides, and customer-facing presentations.
* Act as a trusted partner to strategic sales teams and support key opportunities where required.

**Skills/Experience**
Essential Experience:
  
  

* Significant experience in Product Marketing within a SaaS, software, cloud, managed services, or technology environment.
* Proven success delivering go-to-market strategies that drive market growth, demand generation, and revenue outcomes.
* Experience leading product launches and developing positioning and messaging frameworks.
* Strong sales enablement experience with a track record of supporting commercial success.

Knowledge & Skills:
  
  

* Deep understanding of SaaS business models, customer acquisition, retention, and product adoption strategies.
* Excellent storytelling, communication, copywriting, and presentation skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical solutions into compelling customer-focused value propositions.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset with the ability to use data and insights to influence decision-making.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong project management capabilities with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Leadership & Behaviours:
  
  

* Strategic thinker with a proactive and results-orientated approach.
* Commercially minded with a focus on measurable business outcomes.
* Naturally collaborative with the ability to build strong relationships across technical and commercial teams.
* Passionate about customers, innovation, and market differentiation.

Desirable:
  
  

* Committed to developing people and building a high-performing team culture.
* Experience marketing SaaS, AI, data, or managed services solutions.
* Experience working with vendor alliance programmes and strategic technology partnerships.
